exampleSentence: The pope addressed a large crowd in St. Peter's Square.
exampleTranslation: 教皇在圣彼得广场向一大群人发表讲话。

exampleSentence: The band's popularity grew rapidly after their first album.
exampleTranslation: 这支乐队的受欢迎程度在首张专辑发行后迅速上升。

exampleSentence: The city's population has doubled in the past twenty years.
exampleTranslation: 这座城市的人口在过去二十年里翻了一番。

exampleSentence: The museum displays delicate porcelain from the Ming dynasty.
exampleTranslation: 博物馆展出了明代的精美瓷器。

exampleSentence: We sat on the porch and watched the rain.
exampleTranslation: 我们坐在门廊上看着雨。

exampleSentence: Each pore on your face can become blocked by oil.
exampleTranslation: 脸上的每个毛孔都可能被油脂堵塞。

exampleSentence: She ate a bowl of warm porridge for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: 她早餐吃了一碗热粥。

exampleSentence: The ship arrived at the port before sunrise.
exampleTranslation: 船在日出前抵达港口。

exampleSentence: The porter carried our bags up to the room.
exampleTranslation: 搬运工把我们的行李搬到了房间。

exampleSentence: A large portion of the budget goes to education.
exampleTranslation: 预算的很大一部分用于教育。

exampleSentence: The film tries to portray the king as an ordinary man.
exampleTranslation: 这部电影试图把国王描绘成一个普通人。

exampleSentence: She is learning Portuguese before her trip to Lisbon.
exampleTranslation: 她正在为里斯本之行学习葡萄牙语。

exampleSentence: She likes to pose for photos in front of the old church.
exampleTranslation: 她喜欢在老教堂前摆姿势拍照。

exampleSentence: Please put the chair back in its original position.
exampleTranslation: 请把椅子放回原来的位置。

exampleSentence: The new policy was received positively by most residents.
exampleTranslation: 大多数居民对这项新政策反应积极。

exampleSentence: Many families possess more than one car.
exampleTranslation: 许多家庭拥有不止一辆汽车。

exampleSentence: The possession of a gun is illegal in this country.
exampleTranslation: 在这个国家，持有枪支是违法的。

exampleSentence: There is a real possibility that the flight will be delayed.
exampleTranslation: 航班确实有可能延误。

exampleSentence: The meeting could possibly last until noon.
exampleTranslation: 会议可能会持续到中午。

exampleSentence: I will post the letter this afternoon.
exampleTranslation: 我今天下午会把这封信寄出去。

exampleSentence: The price of the book includes postage and packing.
exampleTranslation: 这本书的价格包含邮费和包装费。

exampleSentence: They hung a poster of the band on the bedroom wall.
exampleTranslation: 他们在卧室墙上挂了一张乐队海报。

exampleSentence: The postman delivers letters to our neighborhood every morning.
exampleTranslation: 邮递员每天早上给我们社区送信。

exampleSentence: They decided to postpone the wedding until next spring.
exampleTranslation: 他们决定把婚礼推迟到明年春天。

exampleSentence: Scientists postulate that dark matter makes up most of the universe.
exampleTranslation: 科学家假设暗物质构成了宇宙的大部分。
